name: Boss Suites Nana
detail: I haven't stayed in several hotels in Bangkok anyway, but these were the main features that I was looking for in a hotel. 1) Clean and fresh looking 2) Free fast wifi 3) Good breakfast 4) Friendly staff 5) Good location where it's happening for a Solo traveler like me. Boss suites has it all. It is just the best and is not too pricey. I wouldn't call it a 4 star but it is very clean and well maintained. Since it is a new hotel, the interior, decor etc are really attractive and well planned ( like the see through bathroom just in case u have one of those special guests :). It is still a good hotel for couples and families but not the location) The price through agoda was $41 as advertised but it will be $49 before checkout. That's Agoda not Boss suites. Most of the staff can speak fairly good English and extremely friendly. My experiences with the friendly staff are too many in the two days that I've stayed. There is not one improvement that I can suggest for this hotel and that is not an exaggeration. This definitely is value for money. You can rely on the staff for numerous things like free Tuk-Tuk (They got one for me even after hours), help with getting a cab, help with your room and facilities and also suggestions on going around in Bangkok at the reception. And ya, for all those fun loving, crazy young travelers like me , the hotel offers VIP massages for about 500 Baht. They are all professional masseurs but you can take the massage a litte further if you like to :)

name: The Bless Hotel & Residence
detail: what can i not say about this hotel? a small tucked away yet very convenient hotel in bangkok to stay in. the staff are all friendly and warm, the rooms are more then what you expect with spacious rooms, kitchen, living, bedroom and bathroom. its like a superior 1 bedroom hotel room with all the perks of a service apartment. if i was staying on a long term basis in bangkok, i could live at bless residence for months comfortably. they serve breakfast daily to your room and anything else you require is right at your door step but with a nice bright drive way to distance yourself from the streets directly. i would recommend this place to all my friends!

name: ibis Bangkok Sukhumvit 4
detail: a very very very very very good hotel ibis nana is a very good hotel and comforts us like staying at my own home when we are staying at ibis nana, it is the world cup 2010.i ask the front desk staff can we watch world cup in the lobby television, the staff immediately says yes and tell us when the world cup is show on live, he will help to switch the television to the channel of the live world cup. that moment i felt that i just stay in a very warm home. also, the staff called jojoe is a hardworking staff. he has a good memory and know us well and treat us like his family members.he guided us the route to the famous big shopping tesco lotus and the naraya bag shop. he also help us to save money and guide us to have sightseeing on the bangkok view by tell us to take bts train instead of take taxi. he just like a master of the family. i hope this positive feedback to ibis nana will not make them proud. i hope they will serve the customers as same as before or better with some tiny things like in a family. i am sure that the next time i travel to bangkok, the hotel in bangkok i choose must be ibis nana.

name: Night Hotel Bangkok - Asoke Sukhumvit 15
detail: I am going to book Dream hotel for the 4th time know!!!! This is the best affordable hotel in Bangkok to my opinion. The hotel is separated in 2 buildings. One hotel is without the swimming pool and the more expensive one (i guess) has the swimming pool. The buildings are 1 minut apart. I have stayed in both of the 2 buildings and they are absolutely great. The rooms are really fabulous and have great comfortable beds. With a nice blue lighting to switch on ore off. They have a perfect airo system. Breakfast is really perfect. You have International foods and Thai dishes. It is a great relaxing get away from Bangkok crowd, but with in 4 minutes you are in the nice crowded area. BTS station is very close, and also great dining area's. Or going out! I already recommended this hotel to two others and they were also very satisfied. So i Will book this for the 4th TIME!!!!!!

name: The Quarter Silom by UHG
detail: Me and my GF decided to change the hotels everyday while we were visiting Bangkok. After we came to the Quater Silom we stopped moving to the other places. Really great place with a perfect location and kind staff. Would come and stay here again! Thanks to the management and to everyone who make this place to be as it is! 🙏

name: Best Comfort Bangkok Hotel
detail: The Best Comfort Bangkok Hotel is situated in a fantastic location on Sukhumvit road soi 19. The Hotel is great for people on a budget as the value for money it offers is better than you will find anywhere else in my opinion. The rooms are clean and comfortable and the free breakfast is basic but decent enough. The best thing for me was how helpfull and friendly the staff are. We arrived at 6am after traveling from over 12 hours. I was expecting to have a wait for the room but no, they handed us the keys straight away and we could finally relax. This was a great thing for them to do and shows how great the staff are at Best Comfort Bangkok Hotel. I will return here again and again.

name: Lucky Hotel Bangkok, Sukhumvit 26
detail: My room was clean, modern, and had a very comfortable bed.

name: Ambassador Hotel Bangkok
detail: A regular visitor to Thailand I stayed in the excellent Ambassador Hotel on Soi 11off Sukhumvit this time. I say excellent because the standard is exactly how a €40+ per night 4 star in Bangkok should be.The Ambassador is a big property with many amenities. The reception area is huge and the staff are friendly and efficient. My luggage was taken from the Taxi and appeared in my room within minutes of me entering my room.The initial impression you get when you walk in to the reception area is 5 star but the rooms put it firmly back in the second division.They are not bad but quite basic. Everything works and at this price you can't ask for more. The WiFi is free and strong but does require constant re-entering of passwords which is annoying at first but you get used to it. Room cleaning is efficient and flexible. Long low timber ceiling corridors give it a kind of old cruise liner feel. Restaurants, Bars, Massage studio, Gym, Tailoring shops, health spa and several coffee shops are among it's many features. And of course that great location close to everything. Some of the best restaurants in Bangkok are here.The very expensive but superb El Gaucho Steakhouse,one of 2 in the area, is right next door. For Mexican try the Coyote across the road. And round the corner the Firehouse serves the best burgers in Bangkok. An Aussie Bar also across the road serves up the traditional full breakfast. I would recommend the Ambassador as a budget hotel without hesitation.

name: Ibis Bangkok Riverside
detail: In summary . . don't stay anywhere else!!! I have stayed at many hotels of different standards in Bangkok and will never stay anywhere else again. The Ibis is superior to hotels 5 and 6 times the price. From the very moment we arrived (late) the staff were professional and SUPER SUPER FRIENDLY. We were even given an upgrade to a river view room which I was not able to book online. This area by the river is great for food and access to all parts of Bangkok. Tuk tuks are a bit of fun if you have not been to Bangkok before but the novelty wears thin before long and the ease and air conditioned comfort of travelling on the trains and buses in Bangkok traffic is a pleasure and much quicker at a tiny fraction of the price. We are keen swimmers and we loved the pool and its location by the river. We love a dip in the morning and also in the evening after a long day of shopping or business. Our only criticism about the pool was that it closes at 7pm and this is much too early we think.It meant that a relaxing swim after a long day was sometimes out of the question. The rooms were so clean.There was a pleasant sitting area in the room and plenty of room for our 2 computers. The TV service was great and very clear with many English speaking channels. BUT HERE IS THE CLINCHER . . and you will understand if you have ever stayed in Asian hotels very much like we have. . the bed was the most comfortable bed we have ever experienced. The bathroom is small but well designed and well appointed and plenty of room for 2 people. Before we left we wanted to thank the manager and left a gift for him and the staff to experience, but we were not able to see him and have not heard back from him. We hope he received it OK! We look forward to returning to Bangkok and to The Ibis Riverside.Here is 3 cheers for the staff (specially the front desk staff and maid service). Thank you and kudos to the manager for having such a happy and professional team.
